summary: an open of mounted KRFFS during the flush that publishes a moved node follows the move: tests/host/fixtures/krffs_open.c over the resolver and the open path extracted unchanged from private copies of vfs.c and syscall_fs.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
f=tests/host/fixtures
python3 $f/extract.py $f/vfs_open.inc -f $s/fs/vfs.c vfs_mount_gone mount_base mount_rdonly vfs_ref_hold vfs_ref_put vfs_enter vfs_leave ns_my_turn vfs_ns_lock vfs_ns_unlock in_groups may_search toward_cwd mount_covering path_last mount_named_at mount_named named_in_rest climbs node_put walk_lock walk_unlock vfs_walk_unlock ref_move_node walk_move walk_root root_current dotdot_stays walk_leaf walk_pages walk_splice walk_link walk_last_comp walk_is_link walk_rest_len walk_name_root walk_name_add walk_name_text walk_name_end resolve_path vfs_resolve vfs_ref_release vfs_desc_open vfs_desc_close vfs_getattr vfs_open_node vfs_release vfs_truncate vfs_create
python3 $f/extract.py $f/syscall_open.inc -f $s/syscall_fs.c '#define O_|CRED_|S_IF' -f $s/syscall_internal.h '#define CRED_' -f $s/syscall_fs.c name_is device_name open_device_name open_link_target node_make open_create open_mounted_node path_starts ofd_record_path open_install open_synth_node do_open
${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -g -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -pthread -c tests/host/fixtures/krffs_open_threads.c -o threads.o
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -pthread -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc $f/krffs_open.c threads.o $s/fs/fd.c $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/krffs_open

faults.summary: a do_open that walks without the namespace lock
